A '''golden shovel''' is the [[Golden equipment|golden]] [[Tools#Shovel|shovel]], crafted from a [[gold ingot]] and two sticks. At speed 15 it is the fastest shovel short of [[Hepatizon Shovel|hepatizon]] and [[Adamant Shovel|adamant]].

=== Loot ===

== Usage ==

=== Digging ===
It breaks shovel blocks at speed 15 and has 350 durability. It has Fortune I, which helps with gravel's flint drop, and it collects snowballs from snow. Golden gear comes with its enchantments already applied. They are ordinary enchantments, so they can be combined or removed like any other.

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|2.5}} damage at an attack speed of 1.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[gold ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one gold ingot.
